comparison.objective: Level and pin-lock a fallen platform before loading two blocks; candidate separates finishing media from workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-aware sequencing, multi-hole pin alignment/insertion and block placement versus controlled screen agitation and particle-size discrimination.
comparison.success_condition: Pin through both walls and lug, platform level, blocks on marks, no hand contact and 3-second clearance versus recovery/retention, no spill, screen support and release dwell.
comparison.reason: The record's core ability is safeguard restoration through aligned pin insertion before loading, not selective separation; generic bimanual load handling does not establish overlap.
